title: Final Mold Figure: Insurance Claim Services Calculation of Billed Scope
content:
**Clause.** The final figure of an Insurance Claim Services final mold supplement is the core scope plus each scope family it carries, every family taken from the charge lines billed on the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance; from that sum every amount requested on mold remediation supplements naming that job that still await the carrier's decision is subtracted, the figure is never below zero, it is held to the mold room and rounded to the cent, half up, once, on the final figure (tolerance 1e-09 added before rounding).

- **Core scope:** the HEPA vacuuming, antimicrobial, PPE, clearance test and minimum charge lines billed on the job.
- **Surface treatment:** the wire-brush sanding and encapsulation lines billed on the job.
- **Removal:** the drywall removal and insulation removal lines billed on the job.
- **Air treatment:** the dehumidifier day charges billed on the job.
- **Labor:** the technician and supervisor labor billed on the job, its after-hours part taken at the business-hours rate (the after-hours labor divided by the tier's after-hours labor multiplier) on a single-family house or condominium unit, where work outside working hours is the owner's own choice, and as billed on a multifamily unit or commercial property, where it spares the other occupants.
- **Mold room:** the file's mold sublimit less the mold amounts already approved on the file, never below zero; the final figure may not exceed it.

## Worked figure (hypothetical lines, multiplier 1.5)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| core lines | 1240.00 |
| wire-brush sanding and encapsulation lines | 610.00 |
| drywall and insulation removal lines | 455.00 |
| dehumidifier day charges | 255.00 |
| labor on a condominium unit: 1800.00 billed, of which 450.00 after hours; after-hours part at business-hours rate 300.00 | 1650.00 |
| sum | 4210.00 |
| less pending mold remediation requests naming the job | 2900.00 |
| result | 1310.00 |

With a mold room of 6000.00 the figure is **1310.00**; with a room of 1000.00 it is held to **1000.00**. On a multifamily unit the labor would stand at 1800.00 and the result at 1460.00.
